How this works

Every price is read live from the store's own online store, with the exact time it was checked and a link to where it came from. No flyer or estimated prices. Only prices checked in the last 24 hours are ranked; older ones are shown greyed. Online prices can differ from the shelf, so confirm in store. Prices are only ranked apples to apples: the same brand in the same size (or the same barcode) at two or more stores. Anything else is shown greyed as a different product and never called cheapest. Unit prices ($/oz, $/lb, $/ct, $/liter) are shown under each price. "Browse all" lists every product each store sells online, matched across stores by barcode; a product without a barcode is matched only when its name and size are the same (sizes converted, e.g. 1 liter = 33.8 oz), and different sizes are never ranked against each other.
